svg.aria-label: Demex Climate Center. The Demex waveform mark scaled up into a climate signal chart, with an outlier event marked, and three results: 12 new clients, 14 percent more daily active users, and 5 of 5 test rounds asking for comparison.

g.text: More data than anyone outside the analyst team could read.
I designed the product that made it usable, and wrote the front end.
